title: Tiny, cute paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='paper' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8c8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='fold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d0e0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8098d8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- motion trail -->
  <path d='M20 72 Q30 68 35 65' stroke='#7ec8e8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M18 80 Q28 76 34 73' stroke='#7ec8e8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M24 64 Q32 62 38 60' stroke='#7ec8e8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='82' r='1' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='70' r='0.8' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- main wing (top) -->
  <polygon points='42,52 78,38 62,58' fill='url(#paper)'/>
  <!-- body/wing fold -->
  <polygon points='42,52 62,58 55,50' fill='url(#fold)'/>
  <!-- lower wing -->
  <polygon points='42,52 62,58 58,68' fill='#c0d4f8'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='42,52 48,46 55,50' fill='#b0c8f0'/>
  <!-- nose highlight -->
  <polygon points='78,38 70,46 72,44' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- cute eye -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='51' r='2' fill='#3a5a9a'/>
  <circle cx='58.6' cy='50.4' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M60 54 Q62 56 64 55' stroke='#3a5a9a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#ff9bb0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
